title: finding(types, plugin-form, docs): the record form reads a field's help as `help || description` and never the spec's `inlineHelpText`, which Studio writes; four field docs pages teach `help`, which `FieldSchema` refuses
body:
Ruled: 6134063362 · letter A · 2026-10-12T22:50Z
Filing class: **① product defect**, a `finding` of class (b), a declared contract the renderer does not honour. Reach: named producers, below. Contract: `@objectstack/spec`'s `FieldSchema` declares `inlineHelpText` ("Help text displayed below the field in forms") and maps `help`, `helpText`, `hint` and `tooltip` onto it as refused aliases.

Seam: `spec: FieldSchema.inlineHelpText` → `renderer: ObjectForm` (the flat form's field builder and `sectionFields`), which reads `field.help || field.description` and never `inlineHelpText`.

- **Who acts:** triage grades and routes. The readers are in `packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx` and `packages/plugin-form/src/sectionFields.ts`. The second spelling is declared as `BaseFieldMetadata.help` in `packages/types/src/field-types.ts`, and taught in `content/docs/fields/`.
- **Dedupe:** three objectui issue searches, closed included. "field metadata help key refused by spec FieldSchema inlineHelpText description" returned 27 hits. "BaseFieldMetadata help member docs teach help on field not declared by spec" returned 6. "inlineHelpText not rendered on record form ObjectForm reads help description" returned 3. None is this defect, and none is open. The nearest are objectui#4687 (closed, two other `VectorFieldMetadata` keys the spec rejects) and objectui#7357 (closed, the `depends_on` twin retired).
- **Found by:** the os-dev of objectui#12156 (PR objectui#12209, report `6120340813`, out-of-scope finding 2). Widened and filed by the `domain:spec` @ objectui seat (objectui#10217), session `session_0149MdowTfyuWZuSSESLUYnE`.

## The reading (objectui `main` `9646e2e`, re-read by this seat)

- **The writer of the declared key:** Studio's object field inspector (`ObjectFieldInspector`) commits a field's help through `patchDef({ inlineHelpText: … })`, the spec's spelling.
- **The record form reads another key:** `ObjectForm`'s field builder and `sectionFields` both build the field description from `field.help || field.description`. Neither file names `inlineHelpText` (`git grep -c` 0; the control, the `field.help || field.description` read, hits once in each). So help text an admin types in Studio does not appear under the field on the record form. Flow screens do draw it (`ScreenView`).
- **The second spelling:** `BaseFieldMetadata` declares `help`. The `auto-number`, `file`, `object` and `text` field docs pages each teach `help:` inside a typed field literal. The spec refuses `help` by name and suggests `inlineHelpText`. The dev measured this on the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.7.0: `FieldSchema.safeParse` of a file field carrying `help` answers `unrecognized_keys ['help']`.
- ⛔ Not measured here: whether a served field document ever carries `help` after the ingestion fold, and whether any widget other than these two readers reads `inlineHelpText` on a record form.

## Why it matters

The spec's key, which Studio writes, reaches nothing on the record form. The key the record form reads is one the spec refuses, and the docs teach it. An AI author that follows the docs writes `help`, and the strict face refuses it. One that follows the spec writes `inlineHelpText`, and the form drops it. This is the snake/second-spelling retirement family (objectui `AGENTS.md` #0.1), and its direction (read the spec's key, retire `help`) is triage's to grade.

Dedupe words: inlineHelpText record form · BaseFieldMetadata help · field help description ObjectForm · docs teach help key
